parameters.name: EndTimeStamp
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. This value is a timestamp.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: RiskLevelList
parameters.description: An array that consists of risk levels.

parameters.name: SrcIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the attack.

parameters.name: StartTimeStamp
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a timestamp.
